Uses of Package
hkust.marketplace.model

Packages that use hkust.marketplace.model
Package
Description
hkust.marketplace.data
Persistence: the serialized DataStore and the demo SeedData.
hkust.marketplace.model
Domain model shared by all three portals: users, listings, deals, chats, reviews, notifications and reports.
hkust.marketplace.service
Business rules for the Buyer Portal (Task 1), reachable through the Marketplace facade.
hkust.marketplace.ui
JavaFX screens of the Buyer Portal (Task 1.1 to 1.10) and the shared look used by the other portals.
